note: Town of Radisson's donation-supported camping area (also called Radisson Community Campground): an open clearing in a 28-acre aspen block between the railway and Highway 16 on the northwest edge of town, reached by the arterial road. No marked sites, tables, washrooms or water were reported in 2025, so it suits a self-contained rig. --Claude
summary: Keep with caveats (town donation campground). Town page current; a July 2025 camper stayed (open clearing, donation box, nothing else). Stored pin is wrong by ~1.6 km (SE arena area) - campground is NW of town at ~52.4684,-107.4015. potable_water true -> false. Count 10 unsourced.
